scope: Versioned documentation coverage, controlled terminology, UK source decisions and styled reference examples. Native runtime and physical-device verification remain separate.

evidence: All 844 browser regressions passed, including all 212 guides and 450 standalone examples, slider alternatives and expanded nested catalogues.
Shared HA example CSS classes, source ownership, labels, responsive behaviour and exact public record checks are enforced by the validation scripts.

checklists.title: Independent review, checks and publication
checks: Cross-review new guides and example records; correct confirmed findings.
Reconcile every route, example, term, inventory entry and source hash.
Pass build, integrity, unit and browser checks.
Publish and verify public routes, records and examples in Chrome.

review_loops.outcome: Replaced the earlier 30-family completeness assumption with explicit current source denominators, exact native vocabulary and eight additional reusable task families.

All nine bounded source findings corrected and reread: source SHA, missing grid class, helper side effects, local Webpage support, slider endpoint focus, premature example feedback, helper creation guarantee, domain meaning and Person away-state omission.

Eight slider tests and five expanded-catalogue tests pass. Fixed enlarged-text overflow and duplicate nested-table region names. Improved tests to expose nested source-member disclosures and check visible links. Manual local Chrome confirmed slider appearance and local feedback.
All 844 browser checks pass. Required GitHub CI and live publication are the remaining gates.

The user was correct that an official UK slider exists. The Royal Navy component was missing from the initial eight-system source set. Current Storybook and released 4.64.2 source are now documented, with 37 current component entries and ten explicitly bounded departmental/discovery checks. The original local controls retain exact values and non-drag alternatives.

limitations: A finite source registry is complete only for its pinned version and recorded extraction scope.
Third-party cards, integration-specific vendor terms and future additions require a new mapping; the fallback pattern is not implementation proof.
Reference examples use synthetic data and do not change a household.
Automated documentation checks do not certify full assistive-technology or native Home Assistant conformance.

manual_checks.outcome: Shared identity/navigation, blue round thumb, quiet track, exact field, step buttons and visible focus confirmed. Entering 20.5 and previewing kept the earlier 19.5 observation unchanged; only explicit local request feedback appeared.
